23 February
On this day in 1953

All Sikh religious functions were banned at Darbar Sahib, Amritsar, by the Indian government

Also on this day

  • 1881Sardar Ajit Singh was born at Khatkadh kala, Jallandar
  • 1921Gurudwara Luliani Sahib was forcibly taken over and brought under the control of SGPC

February in Sikh History

  • Feb 1The British Army announced a revolutionary dress code
  • Feb 2Maharaja Ranjit Singh attacked Kasur, as Quitbuddin had sided against him in the battle of Bhasin
  • Feb 3Baba Ram Singh Namdhari was born
  • Feb 4Khalsa fought against Ruhaliya forces in which Ruhalae lost and left the battle grounds
  • Feb 5Wadda Ghallughara, the Great Holocaust
  • Feb 6SGPC asks government to safeguard Sikh institution of Nankana Sahib
  • Feb 7Master Tara Singh was elected President of SGPC for the third time
  • Feb 8Sikhs fought Timur near Multan during his 2nd invasion but lost Multan city and the fort
  • Feb 91st Shaheedhi Jatha of 500 Akali Sikhs, under the command of Jathedar Udham Singh of village Verpal
  • Feb 10Battle of Sobraon
  • Feb 11Kanwar Naunihal Singh, grand son of Sher-I-Punjab Maharaja Ranjit Singh, was born
  • Feb 12Foundation was laid for a permanent fort at Patiala
  • Feb 13Baba Darbara Singh of the Nirankari movement, passed away
  • Feb 1411 Sikhs killed in a strike observed by the Hindus of Punjab
  • Feb 15The East India Company established a cantonment in Ludhiana
  • Feb 16Foundation stone was laid for the re-construction of Akal Takhat after Operation Bluestar
  • Feb 17The Central Reserve Police Force (CRPF) fired indiscriminately upon Sri Darbar Sahib complex at Amritsar
  • Feb 18Khadur Sahib Gurudwaras were brought under control of SGPC
  • Feb 19Mahants and Pujaris of various historical Gurdwaras
  • Feb 20Saka Nankana Sahib
  • Feb 21Jaito Morcha firing
  • Feb 22Rani Jindan attempted to cross over to the British with Dalip Singh but her attempt was foiled by Sikh army
  • Feb 23All Sikh religious functions were banned at Darbar Sahib, Amritsar, by the Indian government
  • Feb 24An All Party Conference was organized at Sri Akal Takhat, Amritsar for released of Sardar Sewa Singh Thikriwala
  • Feb 25Baba Banda Singh Bahadhur was victorious over Sirhind
  • Feb 26and Feb. 27, an All India Akali Conference (Sarb Hind Akali Conference) was held at Jalandhar, Punjab
  • Feb 27The following 6 Babbar Akalis were hanged to death in Lahore Central Jail
  • Feb 28Bahadur Shah died
